video_title: Shaq says Wemby has to have a 'big man mentality' for the Spurs to win the Finals | Inside the NBA

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaq on the mentality Victor Wembanyama needs to win championships
quotes.excerpt: Whenever he's high scoring and playing like that, the team plays well.
quotes.quote: I don't want you to be like me, I want you to have a certain mentality. The same mentality that I saw him have, the same mentality that I saw Patrick Ewing have, that Draymond Green has. He came out with a lot of energy and a lot of effort. I've seen it in the last series. Whenever he's high scoring and playing like that, the team plays well. I'm not asking him to be me, I'm asking him to have that mentality, because this is what it takes to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the impact of Wembanyama's mental physicality
quotes.excerpt: When he has a mental physicality, it changes the game.
quotes.quote: When he goes after things, it's the same as being physical like Shaq. So when he has a mental physicality, it changes the game. It makes people change their mind in what their decision might be, because no, he's coming, I'm not driving now. So now I have to come up with a whole different plan. But when he's not mentally physical, you go in there and you try things and you make other things happen.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Knicks' failure to challenge Wembanyama early
quotes.excerpt: They never went to Karl-Anthony Towns early. He didn't get his first shot to the second period.
quotes.quote: I blame the Knicks because they let him just play one way. They never went to Karl-Anthony Towns early. He didn't get his first shot to the second period. So when you are a great player, they can't let you just play on one end of the floor. Cat outplayed him in both games. You come out and they say we are going to get Wemby going. Well no, let me get Cat going, then we can go even-steven.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on being labeled a villain by Knicks fans
quotes.excerpt: I guess I'm nowhere near Trae Young level though.
quotes.quote: I guess I'm nowhere near Trae Young level though.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on the intensity of playing at Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: It really shows what teams are made of.
quotes.quote: At home it really feels like playing six against five, and in here it feels like playing five against six. But I agree with Luke, it really shows what teams are made of.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Spurs needing to win Game 4
quotes.excerpt: This was a must-win for the Spurs, not the Knicks.
quotes.quote: This was a must-win for the Spurs, not the Knicks. They got to get. Now the pressure switches back to the Knicks. All the pressure to me, the Spurs had to win the game. The Knicks did not have to win the game. Now I think for the Knicks, they got to come out ready to play Wednesday, because if you give away, go back to San Antonio 2-2, it's going to be a different animal.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Knicks needing to unleash Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: The answer to unleashing him is giving the ball to Karl-Anthony Towns.
quotes.quote: I think what the Knicks need to figure out is how to get Jalen Brunson playing better. Through three games, he has not played well. Out of shots, sometimes empty calories. They need to figure out how to unleash him. And the answer to unleashing him is giving the ball to Karl-Anthony Towns and stop leaving him in front of the defense trying to figure it out. And then they'll give themselves a better chance at going back to San Antonio up 3-1.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Knicks' recurring first-quarter scoring droughts
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks been down at least eight points at the end of the first quarter in every game.
quotes.quote: The Knicks been down at least eight points at the end of the first quarter in every game. That can't happen. Like it can happen one game, it can happen two games, it's happened three games in a row where they've been down at least eight points. That's what I said earlier, that's the number one thing, they got to do the thing with Brunson number one, but they've got to fix that.
